# Getting help with Emura

- **Email:** emura.support@icloud.com, for anything, including private matters.
- **A game or the app doesn't work right:** [report a problem](https://github.com/Nico8324/emura/issues/new/choose).
- **Questions and ideas:** [Discussions](https://github.com/Nico8324/emura/discussions).
- **Help pages:** [nico8324.github.io/emura](https://nico8324.github.io/emura/).

Never share game files, BIOS files or links to them.
